title: Comparing Asthma Action Plans for Pediatric Asthma
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate and compare the relative effectiveness of two asthma action plans (pictorial versus written) in terms of asthma action plan knowledge, medication use, and family satisfaction with asthma education.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children who are new patients
* Receive a diagnosis of persistent asthma
* Are in need of an asthma action plan

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with intermittent asthma
* An established patient who already has an asthma action plan
* Not English or Spanish speaking
